summary.business_type: Local service-area business — solo AI consultant, Beirut, Lebanon (professional services)
top_findings: Not indexed by Google: site:davidgeha.dev returns nothing; no GSC property exists
Entity collision: 'David Geha' on the open web resolves to a TV producer; zero corroboration of the AI-consultant entity
Page-type mismatch: 205-word portfolio landing vs SERPs dominated by directories and 650-2,500-word priced service pages
No Google Business Profile, no phone, zero citations (Local SEO 16/100)
Live FAQPage schema has no visible FAQ (policy violation; fixed in working tree)
quick_wins: Deploy the working tree (+18 health points)
Verify in Google Search Console, submit sitemap, request indexing; add the jarvis service account as a user
Create Google Business Profile as service-area business with the exact name 'David Geha - AI Consultant'
Fill GitHub/LinkedIn/Instagram profiles with bio, Beirut, and the site URL
Set the www -> apex redirect at the Vercel domain level

findings.title: FAQPage schema without visible FAQ
findings.description: Live page has 4 Q&As in JSON-LD and none in the DOM.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in working tree: Faq.jsx + generated JSON-LD. Deploy.

findings.title: Non-JS crawlers see 46 words
findings.description: Client-rendered SPA; raw HTML is a two-line noscript stub.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in tree: prebuild sync-static mirrors Services+FAQ (726 words) into noscript. Prerender/SSG for Phase 3 pages.

findings.title: IndexNow key file 404 in production
findings.description: Key exists locally only.
findings.recommendation: Deploy, then submit via indexnow_submit.py.

findings.title: www.davidgeha.dev serves 200
findings.description: vercel.json host redirect not effective; duplicate crawlable host.
findings.recommendation: Set project-level domain redirect (www -> apex, 308) in Vercel.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: Only HSTS present.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in tree: vercel.json headers (nosniff, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy).

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Specific first-person bio with AUB and named stack

findings.title: Thin content
findings.description: 205 words main copy vs 2,000+ on ranking pages.
findings.recommendation: Working tree adds ~750 words; add case-study metrics and a 600-900 word 'how AI consulting works in Lebanon' section.

findings.title: Target phrases absent from visible copy
findings.description: 'AI consulting' 0, 'AI solutions' 0, 'Beirut' 0 on live page.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in tree via Services/FAQ headings and hero H2.

findings.title: Zero proof signals
findings.description: No metrics, testimonials, client names, dates.
findings.recommendation: One anonymised metric + 2-3 sentence case study per build.

findings.title: Readability
findings.description: FRE 33 / grade 11.7 live; 11 long sentences in pending copy.
findings.recommendation: Split sentences over 25 words.

findings.title: No visible contact block
findings.description: Email only in mailto; osgdev.com domain unexplained.
findings.recommendation: Add Beirut contact block with email/phone; align or explain the email domain.

findings.title: H1 lacked keyword
findings.description: Rendered H1 was the wordmark 'DavidGeha'.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in tree: 'David Geha - AI Consultant in Lebanon' (sr-only tail).

findings.title: #services anchor mislabeled
findings.description: Nav 'services' landed on Recent Builds.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in tree: new Services section owns #services.

findings.title: Three intents on one URL
findings.description: 'AI solutions Lebanon' is a catalog intent.
findings.recommendation: Dedicated pages: /ai-consulting-lebanon/, /ai-solutions-lebanon/ (Phase 3).

findings.title: Missing service catalog, city, contact, WebPage
findings.description: areaServed country-only; no offers/geo/email.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in tree: OfferCatalog, City Beirut (Wikidata), geo, email, priceRange, WebPage, disambiguatingDescription, clean NAP name.

findings.title: FAQPage has no Google rich result since May 2026
findings.description: Kept for Bing/AI consumers; now content-honest.
findings.recommendation: No further investment.

findings.title: Intro curtain blocks content 2.45 s every visit
findings.description: Trace: real content at 3,722 ms mobile.
findings.recommendation: Gate to once per session and/or shorten to <=800 ms (design decision).

findings.title: 1.43 MB hero PNG
findings.description: 74% of page weight.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in tree: WebP 205 KB, verified in WebGL; PNG removed.

findings.title: Google Fonts render-blocking chain
findings.description: ~1.8 s mobile savings flagged despite preload swap.
findings.recommendation: Self-host 4 font files with preload.

findings.title: srcset picked 1280w on mobile
findings.description: sizes too loose.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in tree: sizes=(max-width:768px) calc(100vw - 48px), 640px.

findings.title: Unused JS 48.5 KB
findings.description: WebGL + below-fold code in main chunk.
findings.recommendation: Dynamic-import HeroPortrait and below-fold sections.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt open to all answer engines

findings.title: Entity collision, zero corroboration
findings.description: All web results for the name are the TV producer; no profile/directory links the site.
findings.recommendation: Profiles + directories + GBP + sameAs; disambiguatingDescription added in tree.

findings.title: No question headings / citable passages
findings.description: Zero question H2/H3s, zero 134-167 word passages live.
findings.recommendation: Fixed partially in tree (FAQ H3s, service blocks); make About third-person entity-first.

findings.title: No proof or dates
findings.description: publication date inferred.
findings.recommendation: dateModified added; add case-study metrics and an Updated line.

findings.title: YouTube presence is 100% the producer
findings.description: YouTube is the strongest AI-citation correlate.
findings.recommendation: 3-5 titled pipeline walkthroughs.

findings.title: No responsive variants / dimensions / descriptive alts
findings.description: 1280w served at 634px; alts were bare titles.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in tree.

findings.title: No Google Business Profile
findings.description: 25%-weight dimension at 0.
findings.recommendation: Create SAB GBP; name 'David Geha - AI Consultant'.

findings.title: No phone / WhatsApp
findings.description: Blocks GBP verification and directory listings.
findings.recommendation: Publish a number; add telephone to schema.

findings.title: Zero citations
findings.description: Not on Clutch/GoodFirms/Manifest/TechBehemoths/Consultancy.org/Lebanese directories.
findings.recommendation: Prioritized list in ACTION-PLAN #10.

findings.title: Business name inconsistent
findings.description: Keyword-stuffed variants between live and pending.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in tree; lock the string before first listing.

categories.name: Backlinks
what_works: Niche is not saturated: only zfort.com and eurisko.net appear in Common Crawl

findings.title: Zero known backlinks
findings.description: Domain absent from cc-main-2026-jan-feb-mar; Tier 0 sources only.
findings.recommendation: AUB .edu.lb, GBP, LinkedIn Services, Berytech, Clutch, GoodFirms; free Moz key for a numeric score.

findings.title: Page-type mismatch
findings.description: Portfolio landing vs directory/service-page SERPs; single-URL ceiling ~60.
findings.recommendation: Page set: /, /ai-consulting-lebanon/, /ai-solutions-lebanon/, guide article, /work/*, /about/.

findings.title: Trust lowest for every persona
findings.description: avg 6.4/25; vendor-shortlister persona 26/100.
findings.recommendation: 'At a glance' block (Beirut, from $X, 2-week sprints, EN/AR/FR), priced offers, testimonials, directories.

findings.title: Mobile CTA below fold; no mobile nav
findings.description: CTA at y=824 on 812-px viewport; nav hidden <=1024px.
findings.recommendation: Resize hero at <=768px; add minimal menu.
